records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As our showrooms are now fully reopened, we continue to experience growth as our net sales increased $110.9 million, or 58.1%, to $302.0 million for the thirty-nine weeks ended October 31, 2021, compared to $191.1 million for the thirty-nine weeks ended November 1, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This increase was due in large part to comparable sales increase of $19.5 million, or 53.3%, to $56.1 million in the thirteen weeks ended October 31, 2021, compared to $36.6 million in the thirteen weeks ended November 1, 2020, related to higher point of sales transactions with lower promotional discounting and the addition of 28 new showrooms.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Other sales, which include pop-up-shop sales, shop-in-shop sales, and barter inventory transactions increased $3.9 million, or 52.7%, to $11.4 million in the thirteen weeks ended October 31, 2021 as compared to $7.5 million in the thirteen weeks ended November 1, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: (f)There were no other non-recurring expenses in the thirteen weeks ended October 31, 2021 and November 1, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the thirty-nine weeks ended October 31, 2021, net cash used in operating activities was $15.2 million and consisted of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $48.7 million, net income of $13.3 million, and adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by operating activities of $20.2 million.
